replay.eof_policy: no timer advance beyond last recorded receipt
replay.imu: diagnostic messages only; zero independent IMU factors

trajectory.initial_truth_draw: independent Gaussian world body XY offsets sigma .20m and yaw offset sigma 5deg around initial_prior; initial prior is external uncertain input

timing.header_time: physical sample time, no clock-fit correction
timing.availability: measured per-event CPU duration on serial replay worker; virtual start=max(original receipt,previous virtual finish); include ingest, trigger wait, full solve, monitoring and queue. Also save actual unpaced UTC/elapsed times. No ROS real-time claim.

scenarios.ramp: linear from zero at start to amplitude just before end

threshold_selection.development: 5 nominal runs only; no fault/trajectory-error based choice
threshold_selection.M1: max(1.0,1.25*quantile_0.995 of available max absolute prefit innovations / frozen range_sigma=.2 across 5 nominal dev runs)
threshold_selection.M2: max(.05m,1.25*quantile_0.995 of available max antenna XY full-minus-independent-exclusion distances across same dev runs)
threshold_selection.release: immediate on below threshold; consecutive counter resets on unavailable; no detector feedback to locator
threshold_selection.validity: accepted full graph, >=3 current anchors and current raw XY geometry rank2; M2 additionally all four hypotheses accepted with >=3 current retained anchors, rank2 range geometry and full-rank weighted objective Jacobian; any failed/rank-invalid hypothesis => unavailable, never trusted

metrics.error_reference: Euclidean antenna XY at state measurement time from immutable then-published estimate, never final smoothed state; same trajectory for M0/M1/M2
metrics.intervals: state sample zero-order hold [state_t,next_state_t), clipped to truth horizon; availability hold [monitor_available_t,next_available_t), clipped to horizon; separate axes
metrics.normal_false_alarm: exclude entire injected interval; pre-fault and post-recovery separately; startup unavailable reported
metrics.unalerted_exceedance: report all no-alarm time INCLUDING unavailable; also available-but-no-alarm and unavailable overlap separately
metrics.detection_delay: first alarm about an in-fault state; available_receipt_time-fault_start; short fault without in-fault alarm is undetected
metrics.recovery: first of 3 consecutive recovery-state outputs below error limit or available/no-alarm; relative to fault end; censored at EOF

budget.timeout_policy: save streaming rows and run checkpoint, mark timed_out; never auto-expand grid; resume verifies source/protocol/input hashes and skips completed runs

static_audit.windows: first [3,8)s and existing final endpoint evaluation windows; report odom movement as conditional stationarity check
static_audit.unconfirmed_positions: stability only; not absolute range bias

literature.scope: simplified residual/independent single-anchor solution-separation monitors inspired by these works; no paper-exact reproduction, risk bound, PL, or Hessian 3sigma protection claim
